stories.description: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler in a deal that could rank among the largest in cybersecurity history.

stories.title: Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day
stories.description: A threat actor used autonomous Cairn AI agents to discover and exploit a critical MONAI Label vulnerability.

stories.title: A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats
stories.description: Researchers demonstrated Meta Muse flaws enabling conversation theft and cloud machine takeover; NebuSec says the issues are fixed.

stories.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
stories.description: GnuPG fixes critical GPGME flaw CVE-2026-129975, which malicious OpenPGP keys could trigger to potentially expose application data.

stories.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
stories.description: Suspected China-linked hackers used AI agents to exploit a MONAI Label flaw and gain root access to a university server; no patched release exists.

stories.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS
stories.description: Signal is blocking screenshots by default on Android and iOS to limit AI access to private chats, but warns the protection is incomplete.

stories.title: 6 Critical F5 BIG-IP Vulnerabilities Could Let Hackers Disrupt Websites and Execute Malicious Code
stories.description: F5 released emergency fixes for six critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that could let remote attackers take websites and other services offline without logging in. The flaws affect specific traffic-handling configurations.

stories.title: WhatsApp Android Flaws Could Let Hackers Delete Users’ Files and Expose IP Addresses
stories.description: WhatsApp’s November 2026 security update describes three flaws that could let attackers delete files stored by WhatsApp on Android, expose a user’s IP address, or bypass a security check for Meta AI’s Private Processing service.
